profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Qualified software engineer with broad range of skills.  Works independently and as part of a team.  Develops a solution and sees it through to production.  Utilizes design architecture to quickly debug and resolve problems, always while seeking security and the best user experience.  Interested in new technologies and computer science.

Specialties: 
Cloud computing (OpenStack or Kubernetes)
Media Streaming engineer
Multimedia Design
Software Install engineer
Web Design and development
Application architecture and design
Agile development methodologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading a small team developing management software for a fleet of security devices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on SUSE Containers as a Service Platform (CaaS Platform) which allows customers a full Kubernetes stack combined with the world class SUSE support.
Continuing to build expertise in monitoring, instrumentation, cluster-api, and helm topics.
Picked up role as "Squad Champion" to facilitate communication within team of remote engineers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Owner
positions.description:
Worked with teams across geographies to define work, plan stories, refine requirements, and prioritize activities to develop the next release of SUSE OpenStack Cloud.
Presented at Open Infra Summit Shanghai, October 2019 - https://www.openstack.org/summit/shanghai-2019/summit-schedule/events/23932/transitioning-your-cloud-monitoring-from-ceilometer-to-monasca
Core reviewer in Monasca Project in OpenStack.
Worked with customer support to provide engineering development to resolve customer concerns and fix bugs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Certified Scrum Master, Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
Developing the SUSE OpenStack Cloud, particularly with metering and monitoring.
Core reviewer in Monasca Project in OpenStack.
Worked with customer support to provide engineering development to resolve customer concerns and fix bugs.
Served as Scrum Master to foster good Agile process and communication within the organization
(This position carried over from Hewlett Packard Enterprise as part of the sale of the cloud business to SUSE)

positions.title: Cloud Engineer, Certified ScrumMaster, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Took on Scrum Master role for teleworking team focused on disaster recovery features in Cloud.  Worked on features including database clustering with Galera/Percona, TLS enablement of secure service communication, and version migration.  
Received CSM (Certified Scrum Master) Oct 2016.
Languages: Python, Bash, YAML (Ansible)

positions.title: Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
(began working fully remote in June 2015)
Jumped in to development work on CloudOS orchestration services for OpenStack. Contributed to creation of HP Helion 1.0 release, including security features contributed upstream to OpenStack (look me up on Stackalytics.com or https://review.openstack.org/#/c/113652/). Development of features for HP CloudSystem, especially the CS 9.0 release.
Languages: Java, Ruby (Chef), Python, Bash, YAML (Ansible)
(continued in this position after the HPinc/HPE split)

positions.title: Cloud Engineer
positions.locationName: Corvallis, Oregon, United States and Remote
positions.description:
Jumped in to development work on CloudOS orchestration services for OpenStack. Contributed to creation of HP Helion 1.0 release, including security features contributed upstream to OpenStack (look me up on Stackalytics.com or https://review.openstack.org/#/c/113652/). Development of features for HP CloudSystem, especially the CS 9.0 release.
Languages: Java, Ruby (Chef), Python, Bash, YAML (Ansible)
(continued in this position after the HPinc/HPE split)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Controller software for high speed print module.  Worked with remote Firmware and QA teams to deliver functional product to large printing fulfillment customer.
Languages: Java, Groovy, Scala and C#

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software audio/video pipeline for encoding/decoding and encryption of telepresence streams as part of HP Halo.  Productized technology from HP Labs.  Incorporated new audio/video encoding technology from another companies into high speed, low latency infrastructure component.  Also see patent below.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Began work on HP Instant Delivery, an at-home printing solution for consumers to automatically and on schedule print content from sites such as the New York Times, daily comics, and much more.  Worked on software build and installation (using Wise Installer).
In 2001 moved to an E-Services development operations organization and worked to define processes and policies to enable partner internal organizations to package and install their services for highly available data center external customer use.  Worked on software lifecycles and source control policies, interacting closely with internal partners to understand their requirements and existing processes to drive standardization.
That work led in to the creation of an ecosystem to support E-Service deployment, including a repository for storing and deploying partner software and a repository for XML schemas.
Also worked on the HP Software Update application, to provide functionality similar to Microsoft Update for HP drivers and software applications.  
And some firmware work for Laserjet Printer reporting through a connected reporting mechanism.

volunteerExperiences.description: Internal campaign within HP and HPE to lend money from the foundation through Kiva. Activities included volunteer time spreading the message about the program and encouraging other employees to use their loan credits to support a microloan as they saw fit.
